items.description: The Essex coast from Clacton to and including, St Peters Flat and the Colne and Blackwater estuaries
items.message:
High tides this evening may lead to flooding.
Flooding is possible from 00:45am to 2:45am on Friday 13 November.
Clacton Promenade, Lee-over-Sands and Brightlingsea sea front may see some wave overtopping and spray. The Strood at Mersea Island, Coast Road and car parks on the front at West Mersea, and the Hythe and Promenade at Maldon may be flooded. The detailed forecast is for a peak level at Clacton of 2.71mAODN at 1:45am on Friday 13 November, which is 0.61m above tide tables, Wind Force 5, north westerly. No further high tides are expected over the coming days.
We are closely monitoring the situation .
Take care and avoid walking, cycling or driving through flood water.  
This message will be updated by 10:00AM on Friday 13 November or as the situation changes.

items.description: The tidal Rivers Bure, Ant and Thurne
items.message: High water levels today, Friday 13 November may lead to flooding.  Flooding is possible throughout today, Friday 13 November.  We expect to see high water levels around Potter Heigham, Wroxham boat yards and Ferry Road in Horning. Levels can take several hours to peak. We are not expecting the situation to escalate, or to issue any further warning messages at this time. We are closely monitoring the situation. Avoid coastal roads and low lying roads near rivers, which may be flooded. This message will be updated by 10am Saturday 14 November, or as the situation changes.
